Record notes

Develop stories, revise scenes, preserve canon, and prepare playable GM material with complete craft methods.

Version 0.3.1 includes 9 complete skill procedures. Full canonical methods and launchers; optional provider skills and recipient-owned runtimes are separate dependencies.

Requirements: Your draft, canon notes or game material; Optional AIHumanizer creative prose: aihumanizer@openai-curated-remote; Python >=3.10 and recipient-configured backends for optional Atlas, TTRPG and Draw Think integrations.

License scope: AGPL-3.0-only AND CC-BY-SA-4.0; retained upstream licenses as scoped in LICENSE-SCOPE.json. Read the packaged notices and provenance before reuse.

Install with codex plugin add creative-writing-studio@working-tools after adding JonathanKHobson/working-tools-plugins, or the documented Claude Code marketplace path. Installation and tested compatibility.

This ZIP has its portable manifest at the root, preserves all referenced package files. This release includes a separate per-file hash inventory. Built from 3639f882ecc81e68dfdf549e05de478505974e8e. SHA-256: 704fccd2a43c5c3f7d35e1b1b82832aa60ab3907bf392528fb2c6b8617a0fa01.

Native marketplace distribution is separate from official OpenAI Plugin Directory publication. External provider access remains a prerequisite.
